# FitMe Pro

> Free health, fitness, body-composition, nutrition, running, strength and cardiovascular calculators.

## Purpose

FitMe Pro helps people understand common health and fitness calculations. Calculator outputs are educational estimates, not diagnoses or prescriptions.

## Calculator directory

https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculators

## Main topics

- Body composition
- Weight and BMI
- Calories and metabolism
- Nutrition and macronutrients
- Running and endurance
- Strength and gym performance
- Heart rate and cardiovascular metrics

## Evidence and editorial standards

Evidence sources: https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/journal/evidence-sources
Editorial standards: https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/journal/editorial-standards
About FitMe Pro: https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/about

FitMe Pro prefers authoritative public-health and scientific sources. Examples include WHO, CDC, NIH and NHS. Named equations should be checked against their original research or authoritative methodology before being described as validated for a particular population.

## Limitations

Results depend on the inputs, formula, assumptions, units and reference population. Do not use calculator results to diagnose disease, choose medication doses or replace individualized professional care.

## Ownership

Content and calculator methodology are maintained by the FitMe Pro Editorial Team. No medical credentials are claimed for this team.
